overview: The Medford Park Commission reviewed seasonal field and court permit requests for local sports organizations, approved restricting Tufts Pool day passes to Medford residents, and reviewed results from a recent pickleball survey. The commission approved spring permits for adult tennis, youth soccer, and softball, while granting tentative approval for a new cricket league and tabling an expansion of pickleball courts at Duggar Park.

items.title: Permit Application: Adult Tennis League
items.summary: Approved a spring permit for an adult tennis league to use two courts at Playstead Park on Tuesday and Wednesday evenings through June 21, leaving one court open for residents.

items.title: Permit Application: United India Association
items.summary: Passed over the application because no representative was present.

items.title: Permit Application: Bangladesh Sports Club
items.summary: Granted tentative approval for the Bangladesh Sports Club to use Morrison Park for cricket games and practices through June 30, with the applicant instructed to return with a detailed schedule and use a portable pitch mat instead of a permanent concrete pitch.

items.title: Permit Application: West Medford Open Studios
items.summary: Approved a permit for the West Medford Open Studios event scheduled for June 24 and 25.

items.title: Permit Application: Boston Ski and Sports Club
items.summary: Approved Tuesday and Thursday evening permits for Boston Ski and Sports Club softball at Memorial Field and South Parkfield.

items.title: Permit Application: Medford Youth Soccer
items.summary: Approved the spring permit for Medford Youth Soccer starting the last week of March, subject to Department of Public Works field readiness and requirements to keep goal nets secured.

items.title: Permit Application: Medford Youth Girls Softball
items.summary: Approved field permits for Medford Youth Girls Softball from April 1 to June 30 across multiple city parks, contingent on DPW clearance.

items.title: Permit Application: MassBiotech Softball
items.summary: Approved tentative permit times for MassBiotech Softball to use Memorial Field on Wednesday evenings from 6 to 8 p.m. during May and June.

items.title: Public Inquiries: Carr Park
items.summary: A resident seeking information on Carr Park renovations was advised that the hearing was before the Conservation Commission meeting held earlier that evening.

items.title: Roberts Elementary PTO Donation Request
items.summary: Approved donating a Wright's Pond pass and a Tufts Pool pass to the Roberts Elementary School PTO for a fundraising raffle.

items.title: Tufts Pool Non-Resident Daily Fee Policy
items.summary: Approved eliminating daily drop-in passes for non-residents at Tufts Pool while maintaining annual memberships and allowing members to bring paying guests.

items.title: Pickleball Survey Results and Duggar Park Court Expansion
items.summary: Reviewed results of a city pickleball user survey and tabled a proposed vote on painting a sixth pickleball court at Duggar Park until recreation staff can confirm DPW funding and a project timeline with Hickey Park.
